diagnostics.message: the seat has no sighting of an enemy commander, and the reach window is 180000 ms; with no seat named, the Attack hunts the enemy commander seen within it nearest its staging point when its force is ready to launch, and the force waits until there is one.
diagnostics.beginner: This Attack beacon's raiders wait until your side has recently seen an enemy commander, then hunt the nearest one. Scouts help them find one sooner.
